meta.title: Porcelain Veneers | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: Refine your smile with premium porcelain veneers planned with digital smile design and meticulous British-inspired care in Cairo.

hero.subtitle: Porcelain veneers are planned with a calm, step-by-step approach to improve shape, proportion and harmony while respecting natural tooth structure.

journey.subtitle: From your first consultation to your final porcelain veneers, every stage is carefully planned to maximise comfort, precision and long-term success.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: A calm clinical assessment of your smile, goals and suitability for veneer treatment.

digitalSmileDesign.title: Digital Smile Design
digitalSmileDesign.description: Photography, facial analysis and digital planning shape the intended result before treatment begins.

toothPreparation.title: Tooth Preparation
toothPreparation.description: Selected teeth are prepared conservatively with careful attention to structure and symmetry.

temporaryVeneers.title: Temporary Veneers
temporaryVeneers.description: Temporaries protect the teeth while the final porcelain veneers are crafted.

finalVeneers.title: Final Porcelain Veneers
finalVeneers.description: The final veneers are fitted, refined and checked for harmony, shade and bite.

reviewFollowUp.title: Review & Follow-up
reviewFollowUp.description: Ongoing review helps maintain comfort, appearance and long-term stability.

journey.footnote: Every treatment plan is personalised. Some patients may require additional stages such as minor recontouring or selective preparation before veneer placement.

types.title: Veneer Options Planned Around Your Smile
types.subtitle: The right material is selected according to your clinical needs, the amount of refinement required and the long-term aesthetic result.

porcelain.title: Porcelain Veneers
porcelain.description: Best when a refined cosmetic transformation is required with excellent stain resistance, translucency and a highly natural finish.
porcelain.note: Ideal for: complete smile refinement and lasting aesthetic precision

emax.title: E.max Veneers
emax.description: A strong lithium disilicate option for front teeth where translucency, durability and a polished ceramic appearance are important.
emax.note: Ideal for: strength, translucency and premium anterior cases

composite.title: Composite Veneers
composite.description: Useful when a more conservative or staged approach is preferred, or when subtle enhancement is the right clinical choice.
composite.note: Ideal for: selective improvement and more conservative planning

digitalSmileDesign.title: Precision Before a Tooth Is Prepared
digitalSmileDesign.subtitle: A digital workflow helps define proportions, preview the smile and reduce uncertainty before treatment begins.
digitalSmileDesign.cardTitle: Smile design that is planned, not guessed
digitalSmileDesign.cardDescription: Digital photography, scanner-based records and simulation tools help shape a clear and measured treatment plan.

whyChoose.title: A Smile Design That Feels Natural
whyChoose.subtitle: Veneers are chosen for their ability to refine the smile with precision, discretion and a consistently elegant result.

naturalAesthetics.title: Natural Aesthetics
naturalAesthetics.description: Ceramic surfaces are shaped to reflect light in a subtle, natural way.

minimalPreparation.title: Minimal Preparation
minimalPreparation.description: Treatment is planned conservatively whenever anatomy and smile goals allow.

smileSymmetry.title: Smile Symmetry
smileSymmetry.description: Careful design helps align proportions, contours and visible balance.

longTermBeauty.title: Long-Term Beauty
longTermBeauty.description: A refined finish supports stable appearance when maintained properly.

premiumMaterials.title: Premium Ceramic Materials
premiumMaterials.description: Material choice is guided by translucency, durability and clinical intent.

britishPhilosophy.title: British Treatment Philosophy
britishPhilosophy.description: Measured planning and discreet presentation remain central to the experience.

editorial.title: THE ART OF PORCELAIN VENEERS
editorial.subtitle: A complete editorial study of porcelain veneer layering, presented as a luxury educational exhibition piece.
editorial.openFullscreen: Open porcelain veneers artwork in fullscreen

beforeAfter.title: Clinical Photography Framework
beforeAfter.subtitle: Verified before-and-after photography will be presented here once real veneer cases are professionally documented.
beforeAfter.clinicalDocumentationDescription: This section is reserved for verified veneer cases once professional photography becomes available.

testimonials.title: What Patients Remember
testimonials.subtitle: Beyond the final result, we believe patients should remember the clarity, calm and consideration of the experience itself.

item1.quote: The planning felt precise and calm. Everything was explained carefully and the result looked beautifully natural.

item2.quote: The consultation was thorough without ever feeling rushed. The final result felt balanced, refined and elegant.

item3.quote: The process was discreet, detailed and reassuring. I appreciated how considered every stage felt.

item4.quote: Every step was handled with care and clarity. The smile design discussion was especially helpful.

consultationCta.title: Ready to Refine Your Smile?
consultationCta.description: Every successful veneer treatment begins with a comprehensive consultation. We'll assess your smile, explain every available option and create a personalised treatment plan designed around your clinical needs.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
